text/layout#

Immutable text-layout values.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let block = Indented(
    origin: "first\nsecond",
    prefix: "  ",
).string();
// "  first\n  second"

Description#

Immutable text-layout values.

Every object answers string():

Indented prefixes every nonblank line and preserves line endings. Empty and whitespace-only lines are left unchanged.

Dedented removes the longest exact spaces-and-tabs prefix shared by every nonblank line. It also removes spaces and tabs from otherwise blank lines:

Dedented(origin: "    first\n      second").string();
// "first\n  second"

Wrapped collapses whitespace between words, removes surrounding whitespace, and packs whole words into lines no wider than width. A single word longer than width remains intact on its own line; words are never split:

Wrapped(origin: "one two three", width: 7).string();
// "one two\nthree"

Shortened performs the same whitespace normalization. If the normalized text does not fit, it keeps the longest whole-word prefix for which the exact placeholder also fits:

Shortened(
    origin: "one two three",
    width: 10,
    placeholder: "...",
).string();
// "one two..."

Wrapped requires a positive width. Shortened accepts a nonnegative width, but rejects a placeholder wider than that width. Width and length count Unicode scalar values, consistently with string.length().
